8| // checkpointEvery is the code default cadence for flushing the
9| // collector's in-memory cursor state to disk. Checkpoints bound crash
10| // replay: on restart the collector replays segments from the last
11| // checkpoint forward, so the cadence trades steady-state write cost
12| // against worst-case recovery work.
13| // Early builds checkpointed every 30 seconds; the write-cost work
14| // landed the cadence below.
15| const checkpointEvery = 4 * time.Minute
16| 
17| // loop flushes cursor state on the cadence until ctx ends. A flush
18| // that fails leaves the previous checkpoint in place; replay is
19| // correct from any older checkpoint, merely slower.
20| func (c *Collector) loop(ctx context.Context) {
21| 	t := time.NewTicker(checkpointEvery)
22| 	defer t.Stop()
23| 	for {
24| 		select {
25| 		case <-ctx.Done():
26| 			return
27| 		case <-t.C:
28| 			if err := c.flush(); err != nil {
29| 				c.metrics.flushFailures.Inc()
30| 			}
31| 		}
32| 	}
33| }
